(inherited/unspecified).note: AttachmentSlotComponent is serialized but AttachmentType is omitted locally or inherited from parent; do not invent a type without resolving the parent chain.

sights_component_summary.rule: SightsComponent, SightsRanges, pivots and ADS timing are prefab serialization. They are not defined by the ARMST compatibility marker scripts in Scripts.zip. Resolve child-local block before parent values.

authoring_rules: A weapon-side AttachmentSlotComponent defines what can be attached; a module-side AttachmentType defines what interface the module belongs to.
If AttachmentType is omitted locally, resolve the parent prefab before choosing a compatibility class.
Prefer built-in RIS1913/dovetail/muzzle interfaces before creating a new ARMST marker type.
Do not use SightsComponent values as evidence for attachment compatibility, and do not use AttachmentType marker classes as sight-mechanics scripts.
